# Project Constitution

Version: 0.1.0
Ratification Date: TODO(RATIFICATION_DATE)
Last Amended Date: 2026-10-16

## Principles
- Preserve existing public API behavior.
- Attach testable acceptance criteria to requirements.
- Distinguish observed evidence from unverified assertions.
- Prefer simple scoped implementations.
- Document unresolved assumptions and regressions.

## Governance
- Amendments must be documented with a version bump and dates.
- All changes must be reviewed and approved by maintainers.
- Compliance reviews are performed annually or as required by new features.
EOF"}
